why: Raising C2’s severity made the scorer avoid interior splits of contiguous multi-character units (e.g. 手机, 赫斯佩罗龙, numeral+measure, ‚…的…‘ modifiers), so the prompt now prefers cuts that keep those units intact and thus improved cohesion mainly for short-piece bins where such splits were common; however it also shifted some top-ranked cuts (notably the top-1 choice and punctuation/quote boundaries), producing a few large degradations where punctuation or quotation marks became isolated or cuts moved earlier into awkward positions.
lesson: Preserve multi-character unit integrity but ensure the penalty doesn’t encourage isolating punctuation/quotes or moving the primary cut earlier in ways that break quoted spans or attach punctuation to the wrong piece.
